2608.24263.title: Real-World Knowledge-Guided Change Data Synthesis for Remote Sensing
2608.24263.paper_summary: Change data synthesis provides a cost-effective solution for expanding training data and improving the performance of change detection models. However, existing synthesis methods typically rely on handcrafted rules to simulate changes, where limited coverage of class transitions restricts the diversity of synthesized data, while predefined transition designs limit their flexibility in accommodating varied change types. In this work, we introduce KnowChange, a knowledge-guided change data synthesis framework that leverages pretrained vision-language models as knowledge sources to reason about plausible change locations and class transitions from pre-change scenes and desired change types. By integrating knowledge-guided change simulation with generalizable synthesis models, KnowChange enables flexible synthesis of diverse change types within a unified framework. Extensive experiments demonstrate that KnowChange-generated data consistently outperforms existing synthetic datasets in both synthetic-to-real transfer and synthetic data augmentation, despite being generated at a compact scale. Further analyses show that the knowledge-guided change simulation can be seamlessly integrated into existing synthesis pipelines and enhance the downstream utility of synthesized data.
2608.24263.paper_summary_zh: 變更數據合成提供了一種具有成本效益的解決方案，用於擴展訓練數據並改善變更檢測模型的性能。<lb/>然而，現有的合成方法通常依賴手工制定的規則來模擬變更，其中類別轉換的覆蓋範圍有限，限制了合成數據的多樣性，而預定義的轉換設計則限制了其在適應不同變更類型方面的靈活性。<lb/>在這項工作中，我們介紹了KnowChange，一個知識引導的變更數據合成框架，利用預訓練的視覺-語言模型作為知識來源，推理出從變更前場景和所需變更類型中合理的變更位置和類別轉換。<lb/>通過將知識引導的變更模擬與可泛化的合成模型相結合，KnowChange使得在統一框架內靈活合成多樣的變更類型成為可能。<lb/>大量實驗表明，KnowChange生成的數據在合成到真實轉移和合成數據增強方面始終優於現有的合成數據集，儘管其生成規模較小。<lb/>進一步的分析顯示，知識引導的變更模擬可以無縫集成到現有的合成管道中，並增強合成數據的下游效用。
